headline: Why Xylem (XYL) Stock Is Trading Up Today
summary: Shares of water technology company Xylem (NYSE:XYL) jumped 4.4% in the morning session after the company reported second-quarter results that beat profit estimates and included a raised full-year earnings forecast, despite a miss on other key metrics.
